visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and bangs, wearing a black graphic sweatshirt, stands indoors against a neutral wall, holding a blue glove in clear plastic packaging toward the camera. (2) Close-up shot focusing on the product packaging, which features a red and blue graphic of the "Mt. Fuji" glove design with white mountain peak patterns. (3) The woman removes the blue knitted glove and touches its surface, then holds up a pair of common white cotton industrial work gloves to compare the coarse texture and construction quality. (4) Close-up of the underside of the blue glove reveals small, blue anti-slip plastic dots distributed across the palm and fingers. (5) The woman puts on the blue glove and demonstrates that the small finger is significantly too long for her hand while her facial expression shows skepticism and slight disappointment. (6) Close-up of her hand forming a fist to show the white mountain peak pattern, which fails to align with her knuckles, slipping down towards the fingers instead. (7) She repeatedly adjusts the glove on her hand and makes a fist again to try and get the visual effect to work correctly, looking frustrated at the design execution. (8) The video ends with a freeze-frame of her looking disappointed while bold variety-style text overlays appear across the center of the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins speaking with a high-arousal, animated tone over an upbeat, synthetic pop background music track with a strong 4/4 beat. The distinct crinkling sound of plastic packaging rustles as she moves the product. (2) The narration becomes more analytical as the pitch variability increases; the BGM continues consistently while the acoustic environment remains studio-clean. (3) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effect punctuates a cut to a close-up, followed by the soft frictional sound of knitted fabric being rubbed together. (4) The speaker's tone shifts to comedic frustration, with more rising intonations and rapid speech delivery as she describes fit issues. (5) The audio track features frequent hard cuts between speech segments, with continuous BGM providing a rhythmic bed until the final humorous remark.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a humorous and critical review of a Mt. Fuji-themed glove, highlighting the discrepancy between the cute advertising concept and the poor physical design and fit.
